notes.title: Round 99 - The Spin Update
notes.notes:
Hello! Welcome to Round 99 Update 1.2, a smaller update than 1.1, but still one with crazy new changes!
[list]
[*] Upgrade Speed in shop
[*] Upgrade Jumping in shop
[*] Upgrade Time Control in shop
[*] Player-specific trails
[*] Physics calculations are now 10% faster!
[/list]

...And more!

[h2]This is accompanying a permanent price decrease to $4.99 and a 20% discount, making the game $3.99 for an entire week![/h2]

Check out the trailer to see the new update in action!
[previewyoutube=TJqw_fGgx2o;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











[b]Purchase Round 99 on Steam, or get the Deluxe Edition for an updated OST and DLC![/b]

notes.title: Round 99 Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hey!

So, we have another glorius patch.

It just fixes three tiny things

[b][olist]
[*]Removed shop from the main menu due to being unnecessary and buggy (still available mid-level)
[*]Improved cursor visibility
[*]Improved mouse controls
[/olist][/b]

[i]Make sure to play as much Round 99 as you can! It's only the greatest game known to man![/i]

notes.title: Round 99 - The 4-Star Update
notes.notes:
Hello! Welcome to Round 99 Update 1.1, in which we have a lot of cool new stuff!
[list]
[*] 4-Player Multiplayer
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/737903543088054366/808394706165563452/unknown.png?width=1247&height=702[/img]
[*] Players can now join at any point
[*] Multiplayer Options removed from the main menu
[*] Optimizations that speed up the game around 50%
[*] Bug fixes!
[*] Shop now works correctly, along with now being a feature that can be accessed mid-level
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/737903543088054366/808395136181469254/unknown.png?width=1249&height=702[/img]
[*] Better Difficulty Selection
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/737903543088054366/808395293543497728/unknown.png?width=1247&height=702[/img]
[*] Improved Tutorial
[*] More Sound Effects
[*] Remixed OST
[*] Steam Leaderboard Support
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/737903543088054366/808395541889155162/unknown.png[/img]
[*] Extra particle effects that occur when colliding with terrain
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/737903543088054366/808395947431428157/unknown.png?width=1440&height=690[/img]
[*] Swimming animation in Level 3
[*] Easier to navigate layout of Level 3.
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/737903543088054366/808396655355363388/unknown.png?width=1440&height=692[/img]
[*] Transparent Mini-Map
[*] Slight weapon balancing
[/list]

...And more!

[h2]There's also a 50% discount for all things Round 99, feel free to try the game out if you haven't given it a chance yet.[/h2]

Check out the trailer to see the new update in action!
[previewyoutube=syZa10N5f7U;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











[b]Purchase Round 99 on Steam, or get the Deluxe Edition for an updated OST and DLC![/b]

notes.title: Round 99 Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey!

So, we have a new patch.

It just fixes two minor bugs!

[b][olist]
[*]Fixed inverted drone gun controls.
[*]Fixed background image of Level 2... sorta just ending.
[/olist][/b]

[i]Continue to like the game! It's fun!!!!![/i]

Also, go to sleep, it's [i][b]WAYYYY TOO LATE[/b][/i] to be up.

notes.title: Demo Version 1.4.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to Demo 1.4.0![/h1]

[b]We now have 2 BRAND NEW enemies!

We now have power-ups!

We now have a difficulty setting!

We now have a more exciting camera![/b]
Press C/Press on Right Stick to toggle the action cam!

notes.title: Demo Version 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Welcome to Demo 1.3.0!

You can now use 5-point gun!

This can be used to kill enemies from all across the world while just jumping around.

notes.title: Demo Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Welcome to Demo 1.2.0!

You can now use the homing gun!

This can be used to kill enemies without aiming, or finding enemies that you can't find.

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
The Round 99 Demo is now getting an update!

This is as small as a "medium update" can come.

Different title screen and debug button added.

Other features from the full game being added soon!

Debug Button Guide
_____________
What it does: Teleports you to Round 99, or right before the boss.

How to use it: Press the Back Button on a controller, or PRESS on the mouse scrollwheel.
